verdicts.quote: the first person in line who is eligible (C-37) is booked into the class with no action on their part
the one whose join the app accepted earliest is the first to be offered a freed spot ... the one the app accepted first is ahead ... a freed spot is never taken by a person who is not first in line
Being promoted into one occurrence, or leaving one waitlist, changes no other waitlist entry the member has, including entries for other occurrences at overlapping times.
verdicts.missing: The spec addresses overlap but deliberately does not resolve the other entry; a member can be promoted into two overlapping classes unless existing booking rules happen to refuse it.

verdicts.quote: a member who cancels a booking they received by promotion within 2 hours after being promoted pays none of it, even if the class is inside the app's normal late-cancellation period
A spot counts as freed, and C-5 applies, in exactly these cases: (a) a booking stops being active ... every promotion and every entry removal it causes is complete within 60 seconds
verdicts.missing: Trigger is stated, but a timeliness bound is given only for bulk events; how soon a promotion from a single ordinary cancellation must complete is not stated.

verdicts.quote: goes through every channel the app already uses to confirm bookings ... states that they are now booked, and names the class ... a notice that fails to deliver is retried until it is delivered
no spot is given to two people and none is left free while eligible people are waiting ... After any promotion, an occurrence's active bookings are at most its capacity.
If a member on an occurrence's waitlist comes to hold an active booking in it by any other means ... their entry for that occurrence is removed
verdicts.missing: The race between the waitlisted member's own direct booking attempt and their simultaneous promotion is not stated (which wins, whether they could end up with two bookings or be charged twice).

verdicts.quote: promotion takes the same amount at the moment of promotion (not at joining) ... If it cannot be taken, the member is skipped under C-17 b and no booking exists.
an occurrence's waitlist holds at most 20 members; the 21st person trying to join is refused ... the waitlist is at its size limit
open exactly while the app's clock is earlier than 60 minutes ... before the occurrence's start time ... When it is not open no one can join and no one is promoted.
When staff raise an occurrence's capacity by k, up to k people are promoted, in order ... When staff lower capacity ... no booking is cancelled, the class shows as full
When staff cancel an occurrence, all its waitlist entries are removed and each member receives the notice in C-22. Nobody is promoted.
each entry's position, member name and the date and time they joined ... positions on a waitlist are the whole numbers 1 to N with no gaps and no repeats
verdicts.missing: The entry's states as a record and whether position is stored or derived from join order are not stated.

verdicts.quote: every remaining entry is removed ... The history of C-45 for an occurrence remains visible to staff for 90 days after the occurrence's start time, and is then deleted.
show a waitlisted member as waitlisted for that class together with their current position ... A member never sees another member's name or any identifying detail of anyone on a waitlist
sees its waitlist ordered by position ... A staff member removing an entry makes it disappear ... a history of its waitlist events, each with the time, the member's name
verdicts.missing: Staff promoting someone by hand is not provided or addressed.

verdicts.quote: With the waitlist switched off: no member is shown a join control, every join is refused ... For each occurrence staff can mark joining closed or open
every promotion and every entry removal it causes is complete within 60 seconds
verdicts.missing: The bound is stated only for bulk events; no time bound is given for a promotion following a single cancellation.

verdicts.quote: For an occurrence with a free spot (and no one waiting), booking works exactly as before the feature ... no booking is changed, added or removed.
When the feature first goes live, every occurrence has an empty waitlist and no booking is changed, added or removed.
